upcoming.name: Netra Travel Rider
upcoming.type: Offline Bluetooth intercom for riders (in development, private)
upcoming.summary: Push-to-talk voice intercom for motorbike riders. Scan the creator's QR or enter the channel code to join one private group: incoming voice plays on its own, one button to talk, automatic reconnect. Offline map with your own position, optional in-channel location sharing, SOS alert. Works fully offline over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, no internet, no account. In development in a private repository. Not released yet.

targets.label: Public release target
targets.note: 22 Nov is the outer limit; it may arrive earlier. Release depends on tested features and green checks.

features: Push-to-talk intercom over Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Direct (offline)
Join by scanning the creator's QR or entering the channel code
Auto-play incoming voice, one button to talk, auto-reconnect, mute
Helmet Bluetooth headset support
One speaker at a time, 4-6 riders
Offline map: download a region, see your own position
Optional in-channel location sharing (off by default)
SOS alert to all riders
Works with screen off (foreground service)
Later (v1.1): phone-to-phone map transfer, buddy direction arrow, rally point, leader/sweeper roles, breadcrumb trail, left-group alert
